supersedes.note: The superseded artifact is hash-pinned and left immutable. Its effort facts (high/max only; low->high; xhigh->max; minimal unsupported) conflict with the current official thinking-mode guide and must not be used.

wire.noneEffort: Only part of the Anthropic-format control (reasoning.effort). In the OpenAI-format chat contract thinking is disabled with thinking.type=disabled; none is not a documented reasoning_effort value.

starversePolicy: Starverse encodes thinking.type and reasoning_effort verbatim; it does not remap aliases client-side.
Which efforts a given model offers is a model capability fact, not part of this protocol artifact.
